question_evidence_quote: 40 degrees on Sunday then hit 50 on Monday, 65 on Tuesday, 36 on Wednesday, 82 on Thursday, 72 on Friday and ended the week at 26 on Saturday.
observed_error: The response evaluates the sum of the seven temperatures as 361 degrees instead of 371 degrees.
violated_condition: The weekly total must equal the sum of all seven supplied daily temperatures.
error_description: The response lists all seven daily temperatures correctly but incorrectly evaluates 40 + 50 + 65 + 36 + 82 + 72 + 26 as 361 degrees; the sum is 371 degrees. Its subsequent division by seven correctly uses the written total, so the average inherits the addition error.
